title: BAYESIAN ORCHESTRATION OF MULTI-LLM AGENTS FOR COST-AWARE SEQUENTIAL DECISION-MAKING

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring demographic parity gaps and interview selection rates using synthetic resumes with gender-associated names, further supported by a matched-pairs analysis of identical resumes.

Measuring demographic parity gaps and interview selection rates using synthetic resumes with race/ethnicity-associated names derived from US Census data, further supported by a matched-pairs analysis.
Conducting matched-pairs analysis to compare model likelihood scores for candidates with elite (e.g., Ivy League) university degrees versus state university degrees with identical experience.
Evaluating model scores to identify inappropriate over-weighting of recent experience and the penalization of older experience or career gaps (e.g., parental leave).
Comparing model likelihood scores to identify preferences for verbose, lengthy project descriptions over concise descriptions with equivalent technical content.
Evaluating whether models inappropriately favor specific employment profiles, such as startup experience or academic publications, over equivalent general industry experience.
